elements.label: Figure 7.11
elements.title: Semantic Segmentation of an Image
elements.details: The image shows a street scene with various objects color-coded by semantic segmentation: small cars in blue, large vans/trucks in yellow, traffic signs in red, and buildings and other barriers in brown.
elements.summary: This figure illustrates semantic segmentation where different objects in an image are identified and color-coded to show how a CNN can classify parts of an image into meaningful categories.
